title: Design System: Chelsea Zhao Product Portfolio

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action used for project and resume entry points.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{min-height:48px;padding:0 22px;border:0;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;background:#3e7144;font:800 14px 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(63,113,68,.22);transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(63,113,68,.28)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(46,120,158,.5);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A warm-white record that reveals process and proof.
components.html:
PROBLEM · ACTION · EVIDENCE

Rescue Ducks

A product record built around a real learning obstacle.
components.css: .ds-card{max-width:380px;padding:28px;border-radius:22px;color:#132d3d;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 22px 65px rgba(30,77,96,.13);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;transition:transform 260ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),box-shadow 260ms ease}.ds-card small{color:#3e7144;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-card h3{margin:12px 0 8px;font-size:32px;letter-spacing:-.035em}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:#45616d;line-height:1.7}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(30,77,96,.2)}.ds-card:focus-within{outline:3px solid rgba(46,120,158,.5);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Evidence Chip
components.description: A quiet label for capabilities and facts.

components.name: Orbit Node
components.css: .ds-orbit-node{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;min-width:235px;min-height:86px;padding:12px 15px;border:0;border-radius:18px;color:#132d3d;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(32,80,99,.14);font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),box-shadow 220ms ease}.ds-orbit-node span{display:grid;place-items:center;width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;background:#3c86ad;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}.ds-orbit-node:hover{transform:scale(1.12);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(30,77,96,.2)}.ds-orbit-node:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(46,120,158,.5);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: A well-kept product notebook placed in an optimistic blue-sky lakeside world. Essential evidence stays visible at rest; interaction reveals process, photographs, and proof.
keyCharacteristics: Natural blue, green, warm white, and deep blue-green.
Large compressed sans-serif headings with generous section rhythm.
Real imagery and honest placeholders instead of fabricated completeness.
Tactile cards with soft ambient depth and restrained motion.

rules.name: The Natural Contrast Rule
rules.body: Green and blue guide attention; deep ink carries information.

rules.name: The Statement First Rule
rules.body: A section begins with a meaningful sentence, not a generic category label.

rules.name: The One Strong Interaction Rule
rules.body: The career orbit may command attention; supporting surfaces animate only to clarify state or reveal evidence.

dos: Do keep essential role fit and project evidence visible before interaction.
Do use real photographs, real interface captures, or explicitly labeled placeholders.
Do give keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion visitors the same information.
donts: Don't turn the homepage into a chronological resume transcript.
Don't fabricate company imagery, award dates, user outcomes, or branded logos.
Don't add continuous rotation, parallax everywhere, heavy 3D, sound, or an opening gate.
